content: Charged $83.88 for an annual plan I never chose — refund refused. Signed up for a trial of [MARCA] [MARCA] app and was charged $83.88 for a full annual plan — the page advertises "$6.99/mo" with no clear annual confirmation step. I spotted the charge on my bank statement within the first month, cancelled in the app, and asked for a refund. I even offered to pay the full first month's rate — CEO [NOME] personally refused, telling me the charge was "the contract, in plain English" and that "the onus is on you."

horrible/ sketchy?. I have linked my account to give this a try to use with my [NOME] account, and it is not registering my account, even though my bank has recognized it, and it even told me at one point that it will be done in a couple hours. That was last night, and now it’s not there.
I done this on the app. I’ve done this on the website on my computer. still doesn’t it show up. I just wished [NOME] would use plaid, make my life so much easier. but I do not recommend this app, at least not right now.
